scenario: 今天个性化赛道有 10 篇，4 篇有深度解读。阿里淘宝的 HiRank 让行为序列贯穿排序模型的每一层，线上订单和 GMV 都有提升。Pinterest 不让强化学习直接出价，只让它每天给 PID 控制器调一档参数。另一篇提醒，只用几小时新数据重新校准 CTR 反而常常变差。还有一篇把样本、特征和 embedding 维度三种删减放进一个模型里一起学。做排序和广告出价的团队可以先看 HiRank 和 Pinterest 这两篇。

papers.title: Unified Heterogeneous Feature Interaction via Effective-Rank Scaling for Recommender Systems
papers.authors: Ao Zhang, Haochuan Li, Boya Du, Jian Yang, Qihang Fang, Yulin Xu
papers.abstract: Large-scale industrial ranking models must jointly capture heterogeneous feature interactions, long-term user behaviors, and multi-scenario dependencies under stringent online serving constraints. Existing architectures typically process sequential and non-sequential features with separate modules, limiting bidirectional information exchange. Directly applying homogeneous self-attention to all semantic tokens can also be inefficient when sequential and non-sequential signals exhibit different effective-ranks (eRanks). Meanwhile, shared representations can overlook scenario-specific patterns and induce negative transfer between scenarios. In this paper, we propose HiRank, a unified framework for multi-scenario recommendation that jointly models Heterogeneous feature Interactions via effective-Rank scaling. HiRank integrates gated sequential attention with heterogeneous feature interaction within a unified backbone, enabling bidirectional fusion between sequential and non-sequential representations. HiRank further uses scenario-aware aggregation to compress heterogeneous low-order tokens into a compact representation. Distinct learned projections transform the full compact representation into scenario-aware composite tokens with complementary global feature views and more uniform information density, enabling more effective high-order self-attention. Extensive experiments on industrial-scale datasets demonstrate favorable performance scaling with parameter count and consistent improvements over competitive baselines. Online A/B tests further show a 2.27% increase in orders per user.
papers.summary: 多数线上排序模型先把用户行为序列压成一个固定向量，再交给特征交叉模块，之后的交叉层就看不到具体是哪几次点击、哪几次加购。阿里淘宝的 HiRank 把行为序列一直保留到主干的每一层，并让长期历史的检索 query 从最近的行为序列生成，而不是从年龄、性别这类静态画像生成。在淘宝首页 CVR 预估上，GAUC 从同等参数量下最强基线的 0.7615 提到 0.7801。线上 A/B 中，人均订单数提升 2.27%，人均 GMV 提升 2.86%。

papers.title: Towards a Unified Framework of Optimal Input-Side Dimensional Configuration for Deep CTR Prediction
papers.authors: Chaohua Yang, Fuyuan Lyu, Xing Tang, Dugang Liu, Xiuqiang He, Zhong Ming
papers.abstract: Deep click-through rate (CTR) prediction has achieved substantial success through increasingly expressive feature interaction architectures. However, predictive performance also depends on how input-side information is configured before interaction modeling. Existing studies have shown that selecting informative samples, features, or embedding units can improve prediction accuracy. Nevertheless, they primarily optimize these selection mechanisms independently along a single input-side dimension, overlooking their shared basic form and the inherent dependencies across input levels, thereby limiting the effectiveness of input-side dimensional configuration. To address this issue, we propose OptIDC, a unified framework for Optimal Input-side Dimensional Configuration in deep CTR prediction. OptIDC jointly learns sample, feature, and embedding-unit level configurations within a unified framework by integrating their corresponding selection mechanisms. To explicitly coordinate selection decisions across different levels, OptIDC further introduces a selection-weighted Optimal Transport mechanism that aligns coarse- and fine-grained selections via transport over finite measures, thereby alleviating cross-level selection conflicts while preserving the semantics of each input level. Moreover, OptIDC is model-agnostic and can be seamlessly integrated into existing CTR models. Extensive experiments on four real-world benchmark datasets demonstrate that OptIDC consistently achieves higher AUC than existing input-side selection methods, validating the effectiveness of unified input-side dimensional configuration.
papers.summary: CTR 模型的输入端有三种常见删减，即丢掉质量差的训练样本、关掉没用的特征、剪掉 embedding 里没用的维度，以往的方法一次只做其中一种。深圳大学等单位的这篇论文指出，三者其实是同一个动作，都是给同一个 embedding 张量乘一个掩码，只是粒度不同。它们还互相牵连，一个特征被整个关掉之后，它内部的维度怎么剪都不再起作用。在 Avazu 上用 DNN（多层全连接网络），单独做任何一种选择只把 AUC 提高约 0.001；把三种放进一个模型一起学，并加惩罚让各层决定互相配合后，AUC 从 0.7893 提到 0.7930。以样本和特征这一层为例，惩罚把每个特征 embedding 到样本平均 embedding 的余弦距离按特征门控加权求和，再乘以样本权重，高权重样本若给离群特征开大门控就会被重罚。

papers.title: How Much Fresh Data Should CTR Recalibration Use? A Temporal Evaluation of Post-hoc Calibration
papers.abstract: Offline evaluation of click-through rate (CTR) models still defaults to random splits, although deployed models score future traffic and downstream systems consume calibrated probabilities. On Avazu (40.4M impressions) we train logistic regression (LR), DeepFM, and DCN-v2 under two rolling temporal origins and a random split, three seeds per arm, and recalibrate each test day with Platt scaling and isotonic regression fitted on the preceding hours. At origin 1's nearest test day, random splits report LR's expected calibration error (ECE) at 55-62% of the temporal value in every seed (the deep models' ratio is seed-unstable), and no model's ECE is monotone in temporal distance. With a 6-hour fitting slice, recalibration removes up to 61% of ECE in badly miscalibrated cells but increases it in about a third of applications (14-17 of 48 across seeds). On fixed evaluation sets, a 12-hour slice cuts harm from 13-17 to 3-5 of 36 applications, and 24 hours raises it again. The 12-hour slice subsampled to the 1-hour slice's size (5% of the impressions; 20-25x faster to fit) recovers 88% of the full slice's gain, so impression count alone does not explain it. A slice-ECE gate shows no benefit out-of-origin, and in a simulated auction recalibration moves profit by only about -0.21% to +0.26%. Offline protocols should measure calibration temporally, over multiple origins and seeds; in this data, recalibration fitted on a wide time span beat the freshest few hours, which other logs must confirm.
papers.summary: 广告系统里，用最近几小时的新数据给 CTR 模型做一次校准，通常被当成只赚不赔的例行步骤。这篇论文在 Avazu 十天的广告日志上逐天检验后发现，用前 6 小时数据拟合的校准器，约三分之一的时候反而让校准误差变大，最坏的一次翻了一倍。把拟合窗口拉长到前 12 小时，这种伤害基本消失。作者再从这段时间里均匀抽样，把样本量压到和只用 1 小时数据时一样少，效果几乎和用满整段一样，明显好于真正只看最近 1 小时。所以决定校准效果的是数据覆盖了多长时间，而不是有多少条。

papers.title: Do Similarity Measures Measure Similarity? How User Activity Creates Phantom Correlation in Recommender Systems
papers.authors: Marco Favier, Noah Daniëls, Jens Leysen, Sander Marinus, Bart Goethals
papers.abstract: Item-item similarity is one of the oldest and most foundational signals in recommender systems: two items are assumed to be similar when the same users consume them. Despite the sparsity and scale of interaction data, the implicit assumption across the field is that item co-occurrence reflects genuine shared preference, capturing what users like together. In this paper, we demonstrate that a substantial fraction of observed item-item similarity is an artifact of variance in user activity rather than shared taste. Even if every user consumed items completely independently, differing only in their total consumption volume, standard similarity measures still detect strong associations between items. We term this phenomenon phantom correlation: spurious item association that emerges strictly from heterogeneous user activity in the complete absence of preference structure. Starting from minimal formal assumptions, we show that independent consumption under varying activity is described by a Rasch model, and we derive how the resulting association depends on item popularity for each similarity measure. By comparing our theoretical baseline against real-world benchmark datasets, we reveal the extent to which popular similarity measures reflect phantom correlation, which bears on how item co-occurrence is interpreted and used in collaborative filtering.
papers.summary: 两件物品经常被同一批人消费，不一定说明口味相近。安特卫普大学的这篇论文证明，即使每个用户完全独立、随机地挑物品，只要用户之间活跃度差别大，提升度、余弦、Pearson 这些常用指标也会显示物品两两正相关，作者称之为幻影相关。在 MovieLens-1M 上，81% 的物品对的共现次数落在只考虑用户活跃度的模型预测值的两倍以内，而假设人人一样活跃的独立模型只有 35%。所以算物品相似度之前，应先扣掉活跃度带来的基线，真正的口味信号在偏离基线的那部分里。

papers.title: MIDA: Multi-Interest Decoding with Adaptive Aggregation for Session-based Recommendation
papers.authors: Linjiang Guo, Nitin Bisht, Shiqing Wu, Guandong Xu
papers.abstract: Session-based recommendation (SBR) infers user interest from limited interaction sequences, yet current models show a consistent performance drop when longer histories are available. This degradation is associated with decoder designs that overemphasize recent items while underutilizing distant, yet semantically relevant, interactions, leading to poor modeling of long-range dependencies and multi-interest behaviors. To address this challenge, we introduce MIDA (Multi-Interest Decoding with Adaptive Aggregation for Session-based Recommendation), a lightweight and encoder-agnostic framework that provides a reformulation of the decoding stage. The central design principle is a two-space decoupling: clustering operates on raw item embeddings so that semantic groupings are not distorted by encoder-learned relational biases; encoder outputs are reserved for aggregation, where sequential context remains intact. Concretely, MIDA (i) employs differentiable multi-interest clustering on raw embeddings, preserving semantic structure that encoder representations would otherwise obscure, and (ii) fuses stability and plasticity branches through a gate conditioned on average cluster size, so that the inferred clustering structure directly governs aggregation behavior through a structural coupling across the two stages. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that MIDA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, with meaningful accuracy improvements while remaining computationally practical.
papers.summary: 会话推荐有个反常现象，会话越长、信息越多，下一次点击反而预测得越差，GRU、图网络、Transformer 编码器都是如此。悉尼科技大学等单位的这篇论文把原因归到解码阶段，常见解码器偏重最近几次点击，早先但相关的点击被淹没。MIDA 换掉解码器，在原始物品 embedding 上按相似度把会话聚成几簇兴趣，稳定兴趣是会话里各次点击的加权和，所在簇越大的点击权重越高。再把各簇的平均大小送进一个门控，得到一个比例，混合最近一次点击和稳定兴趣。平均簇越大说明兴趣越集中，稳定兴趣占比越高。它可以接在任何编码器后面。会话越长收益越大：以 GCE-GNN 为编码器时，Yoochoose 上 Recall@5 的提升从短会话的 0.85% 升到 16 次以上点击会话的 3.43%。代价是训练明显变慢。

papers.title: Discovering Topics from Linear Autoencoders
papers.abstract: Linear recommenders and topic models are similar in that they implicitly learn from co-occurrences of items. However, there has been little study of how these two model families are related. In this work, we show that, under a latent-factor model of the user-item interactions, the latent topics can be discovered from the weight matrix of a closed-form linear autoencoder. These topics provide a basis for interpreting the recommendations, and can be obtained directly from the trained recommender without additional training. Building on our analysis, we further propose novel item and user normalizations that prevent popular items and very active users from dominating the topics. Our experiments on six public datasets demonstrate that our method achieves significantly higher topic quality than every dedicated topic model and matches or exceeds the best linear autoencoder on all six datasets, while its recommendation performance is competitive with the best tuned recommender.
papers.summary: EASE 这类线性推荐模型的物品×物品权重矩阵里，其实已经藏着主题。清迈大学的这篇论文证明，如果用户行为符合潜在因子模型，取这张矩阵的前 K 个特征向量，就得到 K 个主题张成的空间。作者据此做出 TEA，同一个模型既给出推荐，也直接读出主题。六个数据集上，它的主题质量显著好于 LDA，推荐效果与最好的方法持平。

papers.title: Theoretically Sound Item Similarity Measures for Recommender Systems
papers.authors: Noah Daniëls, Joey De Pauw, Bart Goethals
papers.abstract: Quantifying the similarity between items is fundamental to neighborhood-based collaborative filtering, yet many commonly used similarity measures are heuristics that lack theoretical justification. The use of heuristics forces practitioners to rely on empirical trial-and-error, offering little insight into why certain measures outperform others or how they might be improved. In this paper, we present a principled approach for designing item similarity measures grounded in probabilistic modeling and parameter estimation. By adopting this formal perspective, we derive two previously overlooked similarity measures based on the Bernoulli and multinomial distributions. Through an extensive ablation study we highlight the critical role of bias, probabilistic smoothing, treating the unknowns correctly, and choosing appropriate probability distributions. Finally, we show that the commonly used cosine similarity can be interpreted as the solution to a specific optimization problem, thereby providing a novel perspective on this decades-old heuristic.
papers.summary: 余弦相似度、条件概率这些物品相似度多是经验公式，说不清为什么好用、该怎么改。安特卫普大学的这篇论文把基于邻居的协同过滤当成朴素贝叶斯分类来推导，得到两种新的相似度，并发现关键在于把交互矩阵里的 0 当成“没见过”而不是“不喜欢”。按多项分布建模的版本，在 Amazon Books 上 Recall@10 为 0.221，比余弦 kNN 的 0.170 高约三成，拟合时间只有 EASE 的 4%；在 MIND 新闻数据上几乎追平 EASE，但在 ML25M 电影数据上不如余弦 kNN。

papers.title: Decomposing Predictive Roles of Semantic and Collaborative Information for Sequential Recommendation
papers.authors: Jiangnan Xia, Yu Yang, Xiang Wang, Ninghao Liu
papers.abstract: Sequential recommendation benefits from incorporating item textual semantics in addition to interaction-based collaborative signals. However, many existing methods simply concatenate or jointly encode semantic and collaborative features, without explicitly modeling how each source contributes to next-item prediction. As a result, predictive signals with fundamentally different roles are often entangled in unified representations, which limits the model's ability to exploit fine-grained predictive information. In this paper, we revisit semantics-enhanced sequential recommendation by introducing an information-theoretic analysis, which decomposes next-item predictive information into three components: shared information, semantic-unique information, and collaborative-unique information. Each component plays a distinct role as predictive evidence and contributes differently to user preference modeling. Guided by this analysis, we propose RIDRec, a novel role-aware sequential recommendation framework. RIDRec learns three role-specialized representations separately through alignment and separation constraints, each independently modeling user preferences, which preserves role distinctiveness and prevents information leakage across roles. Furthermore, RIDRec employs a role-aware fusion mechanism that adaptively combines the three role-specialized representations based on their relevance to the current user context. Extensive experiments on four public benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of RIDRec, showing significant improvements over various existing sequential recommendation methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/jiangnanx129/RIDRec.

papers.title: Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation with Representation-Level User Transfer
papers.authors: Abdulaziz Samra, Nikita Sukhorukov, Alexey Grishanov, Alexey Vasilev, Evgeny Frolov
papers.abstract: Cross-domain sequential recommendation aims to improve next-item prediction in a target domain by leveraging user behavior from auxiliary source domains. However, real-world deployment faces two critical challenges: business constraints that isolate interaction data across domains, and user heterogeneity, where many users lack cross-domain activity. This makes existing cross-domain methods difficult to apply. In this paper, we propose a simple and practical framework for cross-domain sequential recommendations that transfers information exclusively through learned user representations, without sharing raw interaction data or item embeddings across domains. We introduce a lightweight adapter that projects the source-domain user representation into the target-domain embedding space and integrates it with the target interaction sequence. Importantly, when source data is unavailable (i.e., the user observed only in the target domain), the model seamlessly defaults to a robust target-only sequential recommender, retaining benefits from joint training across all users. Extensive experiments were conducted under two setups; one targets benchmarking against previous baselines, while the other focuses on realistic and scalable conditions. Both sets of experiments demonstrate consistent performance gains for shared and unshared users.
papers.summary: 跨域序列推荐的论文大多假设能把两个业务的原始行为数据合在一起训练，而且用户在两边都有记录；现实中数据常因业务规定隔离，很多用户只出现在一个域。Skoltech 和 Sber AI Lab 等单位的 FLADRec 只在域之间传一个固定长度的用户向量：源域模型把用户压成向量，一个轻量适配层把它映射到目标域的 embedding 空间，再直接加到目标域序列里每个物品的 embedding 上，相当于给每一步都附上同一份用户背景，融合后的序列交给 SASRec；没有源域记录的用户跳过融合，照常推荐。在一半用户重叠的大规模数据（从 QK 文章迁移到 QK 视频）上，NDCG@10 比单域 SASRec 高 24%，训练比需要合并数据的 ABXI 快 3.7 到 11.6 倍。不过在允许合并数据的设定下，它在部分数据集上仍不如 ABXI。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning for Controller Parameters in the Auto-Bidding System at Pinterest
papers.authors: Yichu Zhou, Qinyi Chen, Fei Feng, Jacob Loh, Mehdi Ben Ayed, Lin Yang, Andrei Curelea, Jiajing Xu
papers.abstract: Auto-bidding systems in online advertising must balance competing objectives-maximizing budget delivery while minimizing cost per action-across heterogeneous campaigns under non-stationary market conditions. This trade-off evolves over campaign lifespans: early on, cost optimization dominates when budgets roll over; near deadlines, budget delivery becomes urgent. While PID controllers are widely used in production for their stability and interpretability, fixed tunings cannot adapt to diverse campaigns and shifting traffic patterns. We present RLBP (Reinforcement Learning for Bidding Parameters), a hybrid architecture deployed at Pinterest that uses RL as a meta-controller to select campaign-specific PID parameters daily while retaining PID for high-frequency bid adjustments. RLBP trains a multi-head Q-network using a relative-lift reward formulation normalized against the production baseline, and performs inference-time fusion that adapts the cost-delivery trade-off to campaign states without retraining. Through online A/B testing at Pinterest, RLBP achieves a statistically significant reduction in effective cost-per-click (eCPC) with no revenue degradation, and two months of post-rollout measurements against a holdout also show consistent cost reductions. These results demonstrate that meta-controller RL can successfully augment production control systems at scale.
papers.summary: 广告自动出价系统里，PID（比例-积分-微分）控制器根据花费进度不断调整出价，但同一套控制参数要服务几十万个预算、周期、流量各不相同的广告计划。Pinterest 没有让强化学习直接出价，而是每天给每个计划的比例项和积分项各选一个倍数，只能在默认值上调、下调两成或保持不变，PID 照常跑。七天的线上 A/B 中，有效点击成本 eCPC 显著下降 0.25%，收入基本不变；上线两个月后对比留出流量，距离结束还有一周以上的计划 eCPC 低了近 1%。
